result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and delivery info in the horizontal carousel, plus a partially cut-off pizza card image.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with the rest cut off, and its delivery fee text may also be incomplete at the edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card widths and text containers allow full restaurant names to display, or use ellipsis with accessible full name on tap; avoid hard clipping of titles in the carousel.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is cropped such that only the top portion of the pizza image and discount badge are visible, with no restaurant name or details shown in the viewport for that card.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing or card height so key content (name, rating, delivery info) of the next card peeks in more usefully, or ensure cards aren't awkwardly mid-cropped when scrolling stops.

issues.description: Category chips row ends with a partial empty/white chip on the far right, which can look like a broken or incomplete UI element.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll padding and chip rendering don't leave a stray partial blank pill; fade edge or ensure only real categories are partially visible.
